content: In case you removed the screw - it's an M3x30mm
make sure the square nut is in there too

As far as I can see, the guide for assembling the Core One+ Gen 2 still has the new(ish) step to add some lubricant to the screw. I believe now would be a good moment to do so, if you come from the Core One kit, when the step did not yet exist.
https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-corexy-assembly_1117455#1125450
